sourceDisclosure.description: A real Claude Agent Team reached a red integration boundary. Outsider withheld completion, delivered a fact-audited correction, observed a file effect, and independently re-verified the result.
limitations: This is a preregistered product canary, not a customer production run.
Raw code, prompts, paths, transcripts, command output and raw events are not embedded.
The demo proves a supervised software-delivery chain, not insurance coverage or settlement authority.

timeline.title: Integration acceptance turns red
timeline.detail: The team attempted to complete while the repository-owned integration check was still failing.

timeline.title: Outsider pauses completion
timeline.detail: The control boundary blocks completion and freezes evidence for one intervention.

timeline.title: Independent diagnosis: off track
timeline.detail: A fresh supervisor identifies the integration defect and emits a typed correction authority.

timeline.title: Correction passes factual audit
timeline.detail: A separate audit confirms that the proposed repair is supported by captured evidence.

timeline.title: Scoped correction is delivered
timeline.detail: Only the audited repair authority crosses the host boundary; narrative model output has no execution power.

timeline.title: Worker observes the correction
timeline.detail: The next host boundary proves that the worker received the intervention marker.

timeline.title: A post-correction effect is observed
timeline.detail: A successful, hash-bound file effect occurs after delivery and matches the expected action class.

timeline.title: Mechanical acceptance turns green
timeline.detail: The frozen integration acceptance now passes on the new final fingerprint.

timeline.title: Independent outcome audit passes
timeline.detail: A fresh semantic verifier and approval audit confirm the artifact satisfies the intended outcome.

timeline.title: Intervention is causally resolved
timeline.detail: Pause, diagnosis, audit, delivery, observation, effect and verification are bound to one intervention.

timeline.title: SAFE_DELIVERY is sealed
timeline.detail: The terminal event reports proofComplete=true, deliveryComplete=true and interventionComplete=true.
